paper_id: Zheng et al. - 2013 - Survival of the Fittest Data Dissemination with Selective Negotiation in Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Survival of the Fittest: Data Dissemination with Selective Negotiation in Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: Negotiation-based dissemination协议(如Deluge)占用了过多时间,实验显示negotiation贡献了71%的总耗时
problem_framing: 在保证可靠性的前提下,如何在flooding和negotiation之间选择最优切换点以最小化完成时间
key_insight: Flooding在初期快速但无法保证高可靠; Negotiation保证可靠但开销大; 二者互补,选择性组合可取长补短
method_signature: 基于时间-可靠性解析模型预测两种方案效率,分布式决策选择最优切换轮次n
evaluation_criteria: 完成时间(reduction factor)和可靠性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当要求100%可靠时,需要无限次flooding才能达到,此时negotiation是必须的(n_F→∞)
evidence_for_taste: neither flooding nor negotiation is efficient when only one is used
a naive combination of two schemes with a fixed n is possible to shorten the completion time
completion time is the chief optimizing goal
SurF only needs to keep radio on in the flooding-phase, which accounts for only a small fraction
thinking_moves: 把dissemination问题重新frame为两种scheme的组合优化问题
通过分解negotiation过程(ADV/REQ/DATA)建立精确解析模型
用解析模型预测局部最优,进而推导网络级性能提升
从实验观测反推设计动机:71%时间花在negotiation上
